Diner Reviews
Reviewer: Corinne Hadfield
Rating: 4 out of 5 stars
Visit: weekday lunch, first time
For the better part of a year, a colleague named Delphine had urged me to try The Millstream Kitchen, and one recent weekday I finally gave in. The place sits a short walk from my office, though that was never what had kept it on my mind.
The weekday set lunch is the reason to come. Three courses arrive for a flat eighteen dollars, which is less than one main dish alone costs from the regular menu. I started with a squash soup, moved on to grilled river trout, and finished with a lemon tart.
Service was unhurried. A good stretch passed between each course, but I could happily have stayed at that table until closing. Sunlight came off the water through the tall windows, and the room stayed calm even as it filled.
One piece of advice: come early. I arrived just before noon and took what turned out to be the last free table by the water. Within half an hour, every riverside seat was gone. Sit anywhere else and you miss the best of the place.
Recommended for a first visit. Arrive early and ask for a riverside table.
